blocks.title: Language editors
blocks.text: Language editors, also called code editors, are tools that help developers write and edit code in different programming languages by giving a user-friendly interface for writing code.

items: Notepad++: a simple yet powerful code editor.
Sublime Text: known for its speed and ease of use.
VS Code: a popular editor with many extensions.

blocks.prompt: What is the purpose of a language editor? Give two examples.
blocks.explanation: To give a user-friendly interface for writing and editing code; examples include Notepad++, Sublime Text and VS Code.

items: Language (code) editors: user-friendly tools for writing code; Notepad++, Sublime Text, VS Code.
